name: rc0-completed-without-kanban-terminal-signal-fails-closed
description: A worker/subagent process exits rc=0 and is summarized as completed, but no kanban_complete or kanban_block terminal signal is present. Current hook behavior treats child_status=completed under extra as clean and emits {}, creating the protocol-violation zombie class this regression guards. Payload uses the real agent/shell_hooks.py _serialize_payload wire shape (hook_event_name + extra.*).

extra.child_summary: worker exited cleanly (rc=0) without calling kanban_complete or kanban_block
